out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: She described feeling "so light, so free" and briefly hovering over her newborn baby.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: She said it felt like shooting through a tunnel but "couldn't see any sides"; "dark, but illuminated"; later described as "translucent but solid."
tunnel.movement_other_detail: She described tumbling forward/upward at unfathomable speed, like wind "all throughout me. Inside of me," like a rollercoaster rushing feeling.

arrival.other_being_detail: She repeatedly sensed a "presence" accompanying her and later communicated with "the light" (which she equated with God).

environment.environment_other_detail: A "room without walls, without a ceiling, without a floor" with 360-degree vision; darkness "but illuminated"; later an all-filling living light that was "not blinding in the slightest."

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She was shown her newborn and possible futures depending on returning; she understood her purpose/mission as bringing love, helping/healing others, and later described feeling she must help "save the world" and support healing of people and the planet.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe blood loss after episiotomy; during blood transfusion she had a suspected allergic reaction/possibly infected blood; she reported fighting for breath and cyanosis (blue fingernails).

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: She gave 'no comment' for religion, but said she expected to see the 'God' she had been educated about; later described the light as God but avoids the word.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: She reported a sensed accompanying presence; 360-degree vision; merging/oneness with the light; future scenes shown as part of the return decision.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (hovered over newborn) → tunnel/illuminated darkness travel → wall-less 'room' → panoramic life review with re-experiencing and others' emotions → travel again → distant pinpoint of light → merging with light/oneness and telepathic dialogue → shown newborn/future outcomes → agreed to return → rapid backward return into body.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: During tunnel travel she both experienced tumbling and watched herself from a slight distance; also described simultaneously communicating with and being one with the light.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She described simultaneously experiencing and observing herself during the tunnel phase; a 360-degree wall-less 'room' with a black-and-white life 'movie' filling all directions; recovery marked by prolonged depression/suicidal ideation due to longing for 'home'; later reported intentional OBEs during meditation and communications with beings.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Oh, I'm dying." / "It was as if I 'merged' with the light, it absorbed me, I absorbed it, we became One, completely." / "I felt I was 'home'." / "And then I was shooting backwards and it was cold and dark and I was grieving the light before I even hit my body." / "How lucky am I to have tasted Light and still remember the flavor"
